newsitem.title: USA: Decor Group sets stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Decor Group sets stock dividend.

text.p: Decor Group Inc said on Tuesday it has approved a stock dividend of two shares of common stock for each share of common stock outstanding.

The company said in a statement it hopes the move will increase interest in the stock, which went public in early November. The stock dividend is expected to be done before the end of the year, the company said.
Other details were not immediately available.
The company has about 1.6 million shares outstanding.
